text:
Olivia Chen: Heads up -- I hit a pretty deterministic repro where our JS SDK's ESM build breaks auth in edge runtimes when bundled with Vite. App gets into a retry loop (auth header missing) only when using the ESM build + Vite/Rollup. CJS build is fine.

Olivia Chen: Short repro steps: 
1) npx create-vite@latest repro-edge --template vanilla-ts
2) npm i redwood-inference-sdk@beta (local link also reproduces)
3) import the SDK in the edge lambda like: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` then `const client = Redwood.createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })`
4) build with `vite build` and run on Cloudflare Pages Functions / Netlify Edge.

Olivia Chen: Observed: requests to /v1/generate come back 401-ish in our runtime logs and client logs show repeated retries: `no auth header provided, retrying`

Ben R.: :eyes: can you paste the minimal build output / rollup bundle snippet where you're importing? maybe tree-shaking removed the default?

Olivia Chen: Here's what I see in the bundled chunk (abbreviated):
```
// from dist/chunk-XYZ.js
var createClient = function(e){ /* ... */ }
exports.createClient = createClient;
// there is no default export object in the chunk
```

Maya Patel: Hmm that explains it. Vite/Rollup with commonjs interop sometimes turns `export default` into `exports.default` or drops it if the import shape is unexpected. Are you using `esModuleInterop` or `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` in tsconfig?

Olivia Chen: tsconfig has "esModuleInterop": true in the app. SDK is built to both ESM and CJS. Importing `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` works in node dev server, but fails after rollup optimizations for the edge build.

Liam O'Connor: This is consistent with a mismatch between how the bundler handles `require()` -> `import` interop. Two quick workarounds:
- Use named import: `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` (preferred)
- Or change Vite config to keep CommonJS interop: `optimizeDeps: { esbuildOptions: { loader: { '.js':'js' } } }` or `commonjsOptions: { transformMixedEsModules: true }`

Sam G: We saw something similar with webpack when plugin-commonjs rewrites default exports. Another robust workaround is `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` then `const client = (Redwood.default || Redwood).createClient(...)` — ugly but works across bundlers.

Ben R.: For reproducibility: I tried with Rollup config directly and toggling `@rollup/plugin-commonjs` option `requireReturnsDefault: 'auto'` — setting it to `true` made the default export available again. Vite's default commonjs config uses `auto`.

Maya Patel: Can we make the SDK resilient instead of forcing app authors to change configs? Maybe export both default and named API shapes and add a small UMD shim so bundlers always have a default.

Olivia Chen: I tried a local patch to SDK dist: added `module.exports = exports.default || exports` in the CJS build and that fixes the edge build. Happy to open a PR if we agree on the approach.

devx-bot: Created issue #3712: `edge-bundler: ensure default + named exports to avoid interop breakage` (assigned to eng-ml).

Liam O'Connor: Another angle: this also caused a typing churn for TS users because many rely on `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` in samples. If we change samples to named imports we avoid this class of bugs. We should update our quickstarts.

Sam G: FYI this also surfaced an auth/retry behavior quirk: when the SDK doesn't find an auth header it triggers exponential backoff retries client-side which made the runtime logs noisy. We should treat missing auth as immediate failure in edge contexts to avoid function cold time being exhausted by retries.

Olivia Chen: Good point — for edge we should not retry on 401. I'll add a small guard in the edge runtime branch to turn off retries for `status === 401`.

Ben R.: Patch tests: I verified the patched dist (exports normalized + edge no-retry-on-401) on Netlify Edge and Cloudflare Workers — both green. Sample app updated to use named import and docs note about bundler quirks.

Maya Patel: Can someone add a short note in the DevEx guide under "Edge bundlers" with the minimal Vite/webpack/rollup config snippet + the `import * as` fallback? New devs keep hitting this.

Olivia Chen: Will do. I'll also attach the tiny repro repo to the issue. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Liam O'Connor: Note for release: include in changelog under "Fixes" and add a short migration note for any sample apps using default imports.

devx-bot: Linked PR #3789 to issue #3712 and marked release-blocking: false

Olivia Chen: Closing the loop — repro + fix + docs updated in the beta release. If anyone sees related edge auth noise please tag me. :wave:
